game.title: Total War: Warhammer III
game.blurb: Fantasy strategy game with turn-based campaigns and real-time battles, set around the Realm of Chaos, from Creative Assembly, released 2022-02-17. RAWG average playtime: 17 hours. Genres: Action, Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Prologue
chapters.summary: The opening campaign: filling Yuri's army, first battles and buildings in the Chaos Wastes, and finishing the Prologue.

chapters.title: Kislev, Cathay and the Ogre Kingdoms
chapters.summary: Faction goals for Kislev, Cathay and the Ogre Kingdoms: caravans, the Great Bastion, Motherlands, camps and the Great Maw.

chapters.title: The Chaos Gods and the Daemon Prince
chapters.summary: Faction goals for Khorne, Nurgle, Slaanesh, Tzeentch and the Daemon Prince: greater daemons, plagues, gifts and paths.

chapters.title: The Realm of Chaos
chapters.summary: Entering the Realm of Chaos through a Rift and beating the Daemon Prince in each god's realm.

chapters.title: Battles, Heroes and Empire Building
chapters.summary: Winning battles, levelling lords and heroes, special mounts, alliances, trade, income and razing settlements.

chapters.title: Campaign Victories
chapters.summary: Winning a singleplayer campaign with each faction.

chapters.title: Very Hard and Legendary Victories
chapters.summary: Winning a singleplayer campaign with each faction on Very Hard or Legendary.

chapters.title: Trials of Fate
chapters.summary: Score goals in the Black Fire Pass, Hel Fenn, Fallen Gates, Altar of Ultimate Darkness and Realm of Tzeentch Trials.

StrategyWiki: no page for this game, nothing used
Fandom (totalwarwarhammer.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://totalwarwarhammer.fandom.com/wiki/Total_War:_Warhammer_III
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Total War: Warhammer III", "Total War: WARHAMMER III" or "Total War: Warhammer 3". totalwarwarhammer.fandom.com answers the API under "Total War: Warhammer III", with about 122 linked articles, mostly factions, lords and DLC names such as "Shadows of Change", "Thrones of Decay", "Omens of Destruction" and "Immortal Empires"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "ValveTestApp71340" (a placeholder name); the store list confirms app 1142710 as "Total War: WARHAMMER III". None of its 138 Steam achievements is hidden, so there is no spoiler story chapter. 49 achievements are campaign wins (24 normal, 25 Very Hard or Legendary, counting "Legendary Strategist"), split into two chapters. The campaign wins also cover factions such as Beastmen, Bretonnia, Dwarfs, Skaven and Wood Elves; the data does not say which campaign map or DLC each needs. Kislev's quest battle "The Battle for Bokha" sits with the Kislev, Cathay and Ogre chapter; the Ogre caravan raid on Cathay also sits there.
